interpretation: All interventions use future query support labels, so these are hindsight oracle controls, not online update policies or a learned selector.
The experiment separates global decay from the entire Delta correction, not erase from insertion within Delta.
Comparing values of separate gates cannot establish semantic specificity: update-count/budget matching remains a separate necessary control before such a claim.
The new gate interventions can alter later representations and contextualized KV. Neither positive nor negative effects uniquely establish natural recurrent-state damage.
Native and the four trained/deployed configurations must all be retained, including prior Shared/all oracle48to47regression. No training/scaleup is triggered by an oracle maximum.
Only8reused base streams; variants/queries/bindings correlated and not independent confirmation.
Loss interactions are descriptive; signs do not prove path synergy/redundancy or architectural superiority.
